resolved_conflicts.explanation: The 1951 survey names the Arkansas Resources and Development Commission, Division of Forestry and Parks; the site header names the Arkansas Forestry Commission. The sources do not say when the name changed.

sources.title: McNab Unit 10, Tower 4 (quoting National Geodetic Survey station DL1572)

notes_for_editor: Unresolved conflict: the 1950 Hope Star column says the tower burned, while the 1951 survey (quoted on the Central US Lookouts page) describes a standing 112 ft steel tower. Possible explanations include a rebuilt tower or a different tower, but no source says which. The column says north of McNab; the survey says 2.5 miles northwest. The NGS datasheet itself (DL1572) did not return its description in our fetch; the survey text comes from the Central US Lookouts reproduction. The record height of 34.1 m matches 112 ft. The 112 ft figure is the survey's overall height; the survey observed the apex of the cab roof, so it may not be height to the cab floor. No source describes the site today. Status left as unknown in the record.
